The '''Sarm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]] within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarm]].
